note: External reference geometry for blind benchmarks. Nothing here is committed: these are third-party artifacts, and AGENTS.md forbids putting them in this repository. ARCHITECTURE.md 16.6 is the rule they follow instead -- a corpus that stays external and is referenced by stable identity and hash. `tools/corpus.py` fetches them and verifies every digest; a fixture that names one and cannot find it raises FixtureUnavailable rather than skipping silently.

voron2.why: Real functional printed parts designed around standard hardware -- M3 fasteners, 2020 extrusion, MGN rails, GT2 belts. That matters for a blind benchmark: the request can state what the part has to interface with, in the vocabulary a person would actually use, without stating any geometry. The dimensions are the answer and are never in the request.

entries.note: Supports a 3 mm deck panel against extrusion. Single body, watertight, 20.00 x 14.50 x 5.80 mm.
Holds an MGN9 rail true to an extrusion while it is bolted down. Single body, watertight, 26.00 x 20.50 x 10.00 mm.
Retains a bottom panel in the extrusion slot. Single body, watertight, 30.00 x 31.71 x 6.00 mm.
Clamps a GT2 belt end. Single body, watertight, 28.00 x 20.00 x 5.20 mm.
